topics.headline: Both US CPI and Eurozone HICP just cooled, not heated, in June
topics.summary: June prints fell (US to 3.5% from 4.2%, Eurozone to 2.8% from 3.2%), but Iran-driven oil near $100/bbl and ECB's upgraded 2026 inflation forecast (3.0% avg) create real upside risk for the July releases (US Aug 12, EU flash Jul 31), making a simultaneous higher-higher outcome plausible but not the base case.

topics.headline: HY spreads near historic tights at 2.77%, cracks forming beneath surface
topics.summary: The HY OAS sits at 2.77%, in the tightest 5% of readings since 2000, even as private credit defaults hit record highs and the FSB warns of hidden leverage risk; most strategists (LPL, Forbes, Janus Henderson) see spreads as more likely to widen than tighten further over the next month, though no immediate catalyst has emerged.

topics.headline: BTC ETFs snap inflow streak as FOMC decision looms
topics.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw over $465M in outflows on July 23-24, breaking a seven-session, ~$1B inflow run, with markets now pricing 69.5% odds the Fed holds rates on July 29 — a hold could push BTC toward $66-68k, while a hawkish surprise risks $61k or lower.

topics.headline: VIX at 18.58, already above 3-month average, FOMC looms

topics.headline: OpenAI locks 3.2GW Georgia Power deal amid deal-flow surge
topics.summary: OpenAI's 25-year, $30B+ Georgia Power agreement extends an unrelenting streak of hyperscaler power deals (Oklo/X-Energy DOE program, Meta's nuclear pacts), making "yes" nearly certain even as political backlash (NY moratorium, 142 protests) signals rising friction ahead.
